vulnerability_title: [H-07] Missing deadline parameter in register signatures

recommendation.recommendation_text: Introduce a deadline parameter to the signed message and include it in the hash computation. Then, enforce that the deadline has not passed before accepting the signature during execution.

content_code_consistency.content_reasoning: registerAgentsWithSignature builds the message hash from operator, service owner, service ID, agent instances, agent IDs and nonce, and it has no deadline parameter or expiry check. After the signature check it calls registerAgentsTokenDeposit with the operator address, as the finding describes.
patterns_found: operator signature with no deadline or expiry check
bond deposit taken for the operator address after the signature check
issues: The hash itself is built in OperatorSignedHashes.sol and the safeTransferFrom from the operator is in ServiceRegistryTokenUtility; this file shows the call without a deadline.

scsvs_classification.vulnerability_type: signature without deadline can be reused later
